meta-description: Seattle office and retail hardwood: recoat at $1.99/sq ft over a weekend, or full sand at $3.99. Closures, phasing, lease questions, and honest pricing.
post-summary: February 26, 2027 · Most Seattle office and retail floors need a $1.99/sq ft screen and recoat over one weekend, not a $3.99 full sand. The wear patterns that decide it, what fits in a closed weekend, how phased zones work in a space you can’t close, and who typically signs the invoice.
